nodes.label: MS Brand Logo (multimeter over MS monogram)
nodes.rationale: Custom business brand: dark angular 'MS' monogram with a digital multimeter (red/black probes) above it, framed by gold and silver swoosh arcs on a transparent background. The multimeter motif signals an electrical/electronics repair and parts workshop, matching the taller_repuestos (repair shop and spare parts) domain. Maskable variants add safe-zone padding so Android/PWA launchers can crop to circles without clipping the mark.
